subject: What AI helpers will ask you to hand over
headline: Every AI company wants to run your life. What will each one ask you to hand over?

files.name: 1-what-the-reviews-say.png
files.purpose: Muse is an AI assistant that actually does things for you. One person says a shop charged them six thousand dollars for fifteen hundred dollars of clothes, and Muse chased the shop for the money.

files.name: 2-five-bets.png
files.purpose: Each company is going after a different part of your life. Meta wants your personal life, OpenAI wants your work, Google wants your Gmail, Anthropic the careful assistant for work, Apple the private one.

files.name: 3-how-good-are-they.png
files.purpose: Are they any good? They're all about level. CNN tested Muse and found ChatGPT and Gemini could do the same jobs.

files.name: 4-three-places.png
files.purpose: Three options. It stays on your phone. It sits on the company's servers. Or on their servers but encrypted, so even the company can't read it.

files.name: 5-the-ads.png
files.purpose: The ads. Meta makes almost all its money from ads. Shops will pay to be the one Muse recommends.

files.name: 6-my-prediction.png
files.purpose: My prediction: by 30 June 2027 OpenAI, Google or Anthropic will launch an assistant that shops for you, with your data encrypted, even from them. 55%.
